title: KnotUp 1.2.8
description: Restore KnotUp's glossy 3D feature icons, including the To-Do Trash icon, and refresh Journal mood icon visuals.
Add Finance receipt and screenshot OCR using on-device text recognition for images and PDFs.
Prefill the existing Income/Expense transaction form with detected details for user review; preserve original receipt files and support multiple attachments.
Match detected bank and masked account details to registered accounts when unambiguous, and prevent duplicates based on transaction identifiers.
Failed and pending receipts are not saved as completed transactions.
Receipt interpretation currently uses on-device OCR and conservative parsing. A secure AI document-understanding backend is not configured in this release.
